name: eagle-sdd
description: Spec-driven development for coding agents: a dated design document paired with a task-by-task implementation plan.

interface.shortDescription: Design first, plan task by task, verify against the design
interface.longDescription: Guides a change through orient, grill, design document, plan document, implement, verify, and close. Each change produces a dated design document and a dated implementation plan under docs/eagle-sdd, frozen at their date, with a verification step and a commit per task.
